rule: The aim is not to win but to avoid being the Bhabhi. Fail to follow suit and you take the whole pile into your hand. Players who empty their hand drop out; the last one still holding cards is the Bhabhi.
leadLine: Led: {{suit}} ({{n}} on the table -- fail to follow and you take them all)
leadNone: The table is empty. Lead whatever you like.
gameEndYou: Game over! You are the Bhabhi.
gameEndStalemate: Deadlocked after {{tricks}} tricks. {{name}} holds the most cards and is the Bhabhi.
hintReasonLead: lead from the suit you hold most of
hintReasonDuck: you can follow -- play low and let it go
hintReasonDumpHigh: you cannot follow, so you take the pile anyway -- dump a high card
